digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center binding store and reconciliation
propositions: A Jira issue's KEY changes when moved between projects but its numeric ID remains immutable; bindings keyed on KEY can silently detach when moved_issue_key table fails to update and the old key stops resolving
The absence probe incorrectly retires issues that are still reachable by their numeric ID after a project move, orphaning live tickets
Recording the numeric jira_id alongside the key on binding creation and re-asking by ID on a 404 recovers moved bindings without changing the key-keyed store identity or impacting Cloud deployments
The reverse index must be updated atomically with the key re-key operation to prevent stale entries from re-detaching the binding on subsequent reconciliation passes
Pre-existing bindings without a recorded jira_id must degrade gracefully with no migration required, treating the absence exactly as before if no fallback ID is available
